scenicChapters.title: German Fairy Tale Route
scenicChapters.narrative: Expect company on a summer weekend. Early is better than fast. For 43 km this is German Fairy Tale Route, a road with a name of its own and a reason for it.

places-watchtower-wp-7-37-watchtowers-wp.story: A 355 km round trip from Walldürn - roughly 6 h 07 in the saddle. The stops in between: Fort site and civil settlement of Trennfur, Fort site and civil settlement of Seligens, Fortsite and civil settlement of Ober-Flor and Watchtowers WP 3/24 to 3/40Watchtowers WP. The line favours views over speed.
